Q: Subfile WRITE fails with CPF5021 (status 9N / extended status 831D), even on a minimal test program A:

first of all it's better if you edit your question instead of commenting into it.

Look closely at your CPF5022 error description:

Input operation to an output-only file, or READ operation to a subfile control record format without SFLDSPCTL in effect.

Add a 1-byte, non-display both (B) field to the SFLCTL format so COBOL has something to read.

A            DUMMY          1A  B 24  1DSPATR(ND)

I think it should solve the problem

Q: How to read large zip files in pyspark A:

I did read the contents of zip files in chunks, and processed those chunks using spark. This worked for me, and helped me to read zip files having size more than 10G. Below is example set: 

max_data_length=10000
z = zipfile.ZipFile(zip_file)
data = []
counter=1
with z.open(z.infolist()[0]) as f:
    line_counter=0
    for line in f:
        # Append file contents to list
        data.append(line)
        line_counter=line_counter+1
        # Reset counters if record count hit max-data-length threshold
        # Create spark dataframes
        if not line_counter % max_data_length:          
            # Spark processing like:
            df_rdd = spark.sparkContext.parallelize(data)

            # Reset Counters and data-list
            counter=counter+1
            line_counter=0
            data= []

Q: How to find all the IP addresses a application uses? A:

Used Microsoft network monitor, Works really well once you start the process on there and start the application the left hand panel will show up with traffics on the apps that are connecting to the internet.
